storySection.title: Crafting Luxury Through Digital Precision
paragraphs: Kohler has established a brand synonymous with timeless luxury and innovation. Their offerings are more than just bathroom fixtures — they are masterpieces of engineering and design excellence.

The challenge was to visually communicate this craftsmanship without the logistical complexity and expense of high-end photoshoots. Kohler needed an intelligent, scalable solution to replicate the realism of photography using CGI, while maintaining luxury standards.
That’s where Prakria’s advanced 3D modeling, 3D animation, and CGI expertise came into play — blending art and technology to create visuals that embodied Kohler’s brand philosophy.

challenge.description: Kohler sought a partner who could go beyond simple visual creation — they needed an animation studio that understood the brand’s passion for perfection. They needed high-end 3D artistry fused with global luxury sensibilities.

Seamless scalability across markets
Consistent, brand-aligned CGI outputs
Rapid delivery without compromising quality

storySection.title: Indulgence, Rendered to Perfection
paragraphs: KitKat was preparing to announce a new premium line — KitKat Dessert Delight. Inspired by desserts, this new range needed to visually express indulgence and make audiences crave the product at first glance.

The goal was to create a key visual so mouth-watering that people could almost taste the product through the screen. However, traditional food photography came with challenges like melting textures, complex setups, and long production cycles.
Working on tight deadlines, the brand needed a smarter and faster approach to execute the campaign while maintaining high visual quality — that’s when Prakria stepped in.

challenge.title: Why Prakria?
challenge.description: KitKat turned to Prakria for our mastery in 3D modeling, 3D animation, and CGI artistry. We don’t just produce visuals — we craft experiences that blend realism with emotion. Our approach combines artistry, precision, and cinematic storytelling to make brands come alive digitally.
list: World-class 3D modeling and animation expertise
VFX and 2D animation integration for realism and emotion
Cinematic quality rendering for photorealistic results
Faster digital workflow replacing complex physical shoots
Strategic storytelling aligned with brand indulgence

The brand needed a smarter, more adaptable solution — one that could digitally replicate the flow and luminosity of water with complete precision.

storySection.title: Digital Realism for Nature’s Complexity
paragraphs: Few things are as challenging as capturing the natural juiciness, surface detail, and vibrancy of fruits and nuts. Each element — texture, translucency, reflection — must feel authentic and harmonious to recreate nature’s complexity.
Prakria was hired to elevate existing product photography into a sensory digital feast. The goal was to make viewers feel the crunch, the creaminess, the juiciness — without ever shooting real food.

Because physical shoots come with issues like perishability, lighting inconsistency, and setup limitations, Prakria proposed a complete 3D route — building the entire visual world through digital craft.

challenge.title: Why Prakria?
challenge.description: Prakria stands apart as not just a design studio but an advanced animation and CGI powerhouse capable of merging artistry with technical realism. For Fruits and Nuts 3D, the challenge wasn’t simply to create visuals — it was to simulate the behavior, texture, and light response of real ingredients across multiple formats.
list: End-to-end expertise in 3D modeling, animation, and VFX
Photorealistic material design for high-detail textures
Cross-platform adaptability — print, motion, interactive
Experience in creating emotion-driven CGI for food brands
Streamlined digital pipeline for speed and scalability

startageySection.title: Our Solution — Digital Nature, Perfected
startageySection.description: We recreated the beauty of nature’s ingredients entirely in 3D, combining advanced CGI artistry with cinematic control over every droplet, reflection, and light source.

list.description: Modeled fruits, nuts, shells, leaves, and juice drops with microscopic detail — replicating real-world translucency, irregularity, and texture.

list.title: 3D Design
list.description: Composed layouts with natural movement and rhythm, using negative space and scale to make visuals breathe and feel organic.

list.title: 3D & VFX Animation
list.description: Simulated fruit rolls, nut cracks, and juice splashes, enhanced with soft VFX layers like mist, micro droplets, and glints for cinematic realism.

list.title: 2D Animation Enhancements
